CANDIDATE_BINDING.rule: This record ratifies ONE owner decision AGAINST ONE EXACT EFFECTIVE PACKAGE, identified by the lane HEAD commit SHA and, independently, by the git blob SHA of each of the four Track A DAG artifacts it companions. Both must be re-derivable by inspection at any later time. If either check fails, the correct response is STOP_RATIFICATION_BINDING_MISMATCH - this record does not apply to a different candidate and must not be read as ratifying one.
CANDIDATE_BINDING.candidate_commit_verification: git rev-parse HEAD, on branch codex/cv1-m11-track-a-implementation-dag-authority-r1, at materialization.
CANDIDATE_BINDING.verification_method: git rev-parse <candidate_commit_sha>:<artifact path>, compared against expected_blob_sha1, for each of the four artifacts.
CANDIDATE_BINDING.on_mismatch: STOP_RATIFICATION_BINDING_MISMATCH. Any later amendment to any of the four artifacts (v1.0.2 or beyond) requires a SUCCESSOR ratification record binding to the new candidate; it does not retroactively apply to this one.

NONBLOCKING_FINDING_CARRYOVER.occurred_vs_materialized: OCCURRED_PER_DIRECTING_MISSION / NOT_MATERIALIZED_IN_TREE. Consistent with this lane's own established treatment of PRE-1 (v1.0.0 DERIVATION_PRECONDITIONS.preconditions[PRE-1]): an owner-directed, affirmed certification with no committed verdict artifact is not the same as one that did not occur. It is ALSO not the same as one this record can cite substantive content from - that is the genuine limitation stated in what_this_record_cannot_do below.
NONBLOCKING_FINDING_CARRYOVER.rule: Findings NB-R1, NB-R2, NB-R3, NB-R4, NB-R6 and NB-R7 and NB-R8 are named by the directing mission as nonblocking findings of that recertification, to be carried forward as Track A implementation requirements. NB-R5 is CONSPICUOUSLY ABSENT from the directing mission's own enumeration and is NOT assumed, renumbered, backfilled, or silently skipped over without mention by this record.
NONBLOCKING_FINDING_CARRYOVER.what_this_record_cannot_do: This record does NOT fabricate substantive text for NB-R1..NB-R4 or NB-R6..NB-R8. No recertification artifact naming their content exists in the repository tree, and the directing mission supplied only the seven identifiers, not their text. Inventing plausible findings under these identifiers would be evidence fabrication - exactly the class of error this repository's own practice (ATTESTED != PROVEN, applied throughout the M11 and CV1-D1 lanes' own nonblocking-finding carryovers) exists to prevent.
NONBLOCKING_FINDING_CARRYOVER.what_this_record_does_instead: Names the seven identifiers, records the obligation the directing mission places on them (carry forward as Track A implementation requirements), and states plainly that a future implementation lane MUST locate each finding's actual text - from the recertification's own eventual materialization, or from the conversation that produced the verdict - before treating any of NB-R1..NB-R4 or NB-R6..NB-R8 as satisfied, deferred, or closed. An implementation lane that proceeds without locating this content is proceeding with an INCOMPLETE requirement set, and this record says so explicitly rather than silently treating seven unread findings as already closed.
